candidate.selection_basis: Dispatch-24 selection rule: most recent technically-valid, non-catastrophic checkpoint with complete provenance. QAT-20 excluded (Dispatch-20/23 evidence: catastrophically degenerate, 0/7 mechanical). LoRA-20 is the best available non-excluded candidate (4/7 mechanical; partially degenerate but not catastrophic) and runs the fast path (base+adapter, no fake-quant). Experimental smoke checkpoint; not a quality claim.
